Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Students use tweezers and magnifying glasses to examine a piece of mold on bread. Which should they also use for safety in this investigation?
A. bright light
B. dark glasses
C. breathing masks
D. hot plates
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
